title: platform-standup-2026-03-13
content:
Attendees: Aisha, Liam, Maya, Diego, Priya, Jordan (ops)
Duration: 15m

Quick updates:
- Control plane: rollout of the routing-weighted rollout landed on staging. Observed ~2% increase in decision latency under synthetic load; investigating kernel scheduling tweaks (PR #456). Will revert if production spike observed. (Owner: Aisha)
- Routing: added tag-based routing for model variants; feature flag enabled for 10% of traffic. Need to confirm fallback path when variant not available (edge case PLAT-2345). Next: add metrics for variant mismatch counts. (Owner: Liam)
- Auth: short-lived tokens rollout proceeding. Token refresh endpoint implemented, but noticed repeated 401s from Dedicated test cluster when TTL <= 30s. Hypothesis: clock drift between service nodes; Diego to add clock-sync check to health probe. (Owner: Diego)
- Quotas & rate limiting: quota enforcement bug affecting batched requests was reproduced — quota step applied per batch instead of per logical request, causing undercounting. Hotfix merged to staging; will promote to canary after smoke tests. (Owner: Maya)

Blocked/risks:
- Control plane decision latency regression could impact P99 on small bursty requests; if reproduced in canary we'll roll back and open incident. (Aisha)
- Auth 401s blocking Dedicated customer test — need urgent fix for clock sync or to increase token grace window for now. (Diego, high priority)
- Quota bug may have allowed over-quota usage during yesterday's spike; need usage reconciliation and potential invoicing guardrails. (Maya, Finance follow-up)

Action items:
- Aisha: Add additional CPU profiling on control plane under 95th/99th percentile tail workloads; target complete by EOD 2026-03-14.
- Liam: Instrument variant-mismatch metric and create dashboard tile; aim to ship by 2026-03-15.
- Diego: Add clock-sync probe and temporary increased token grace window for Dedicated; target hotfix 2026-03-13 afternoon.
- Maya: Run quota reconciliation job for last 24h and document any overages; coordinate with finance and CS.
- Priya: Draft customer-facing note for Dedicated test disruption and proposed ETA for fix; share in #customer-success by EOD.

Notes / Decisions:
- Agreed to keep new routing flag at 10% traffic until variant mismatch metric is in place.
- For token TTLs <=30s, opting for a short-term increase to 60s in Dedicated clusters until a clock-sync solution is validated.

Links & refs:
- PLAT-2345: routing fallback edge case ticket (priority P2)
- Confluence: Control Plane Design page (link above)
- Slack thread: #platform-engineering about token TTLs (see linked_artifacts)

Next meeting: daily standup 2026-03-16 10:00am PT (usual channel)

Notes to self: remind infra to check NTP config on new Dedicated nodes; consider adding automated drift alerts to SRE runbook.
